answer: Each identity holds one yarrow plot under a quartz sundial, locking a 70-credit bond that decays 5 an epoch. At dawn the holder files a yarrow-growth reading against the quartz table; a missed reading or one over 3% off burns the bond. Renewal costs 30, so 1,000 fake plots lock 70,000 and bleed 30,000 an epoch; one key cannot file two dawn readings at once, so rented plots fail. Honest gardeners pay 30 an epoch and keep the bond alive.
